- Soybean leaf with large, irregular pale yellow/chlorotic patches covering the right side and tip
- Yellowing appears to be somewhat inter-veinal (veins still slightly visible/greenish within yellow zone)
- No discrete brown spots, no pustules, no white powdery coating visible
- The yellowing is diffuse and concentrated on one portion of the leaf

**Reference comparison:**
- Downy mildew shows pale yellow angular/irregular lesions on the upper leaf surface with potential sporulation below — matches the pale yellow diffuse discoloration pattern
- The large irregular pale yellow patches on upper leaf surface are characteristic of Downy mildew
